purpose: Test whether top historical challenger parties against the current Nash mixture (APEX4 in data/kodoku-r3/conclusion-equilibrium-deme.json) achieve > 50% when both sides use the repaired bot under identical production settings (data/live-search.json).
selection: Highest historical opponent score against current APEX4 mixture in data/kodoku-r3/apex-exp-cache.json (0.474688 = 1 - 0.525312148962149), plus top catalog challengers (sample-07, mjj-2010-garap-a, pb-100, sample-08).
symmetric_production_policy: Both Blue (APEX4 mixture) and Red (challenger party) use ProtocolAgent + PlayerChannel, c = 0.4, SelRule::Ucb, unmodified data/belief-pool-v3/belief-pool.json prior, legacy best() action policy, and data/compiled-preview-v1.json choices[u32(seed) % 64] when the matchup key is present (falling back to 729,000 live preview search iterations when off-catalog).
